gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
x / y  —  the HP you'll actually lose this turn if you end now (after block)
over the raw damage the enemies are outputting.
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
x / y  —  the most HP you can deal this turn over that plus damage that lands before
your next play (poison, start-of-turn effects, …). Hover an enemy to scope both numbers to it.
